us.conditions: US citizens can enter Botswana visa-free for tourist stays of up to 90 days in any 12-month period.

de.conditions: German and EU citizens do not need a visa for tourist visits of up to 90 days in Botswana.

gb.conditions: British citizens do not require a visa to visit Botswana for stays of up to 90 days.

ru.conditions: Граждане РФ могут въезжать в Ботсвану без визы на срок до 90 дней с туристическими целями.

dos.title: Experience an Okavango Delta Mokoro canoe trip
dos.description: Gliding silently through the papyrus channels of the Okavango Delta in a traditional wooden or fiberglass canoe (Mokoro) is unforgettable.

dos.title: Greet with 'Dumela' (Hello in Setswana)
dos.description: 'Dumela Rra' (to a man) or 'Dumela Mma' (to a woman) is the polite customary greeting across Botswana.

dos.title: Respect Botswana's world-class conservation laws
dos.description: Botswana maintains low-impact, high-value eco-tourism; never litter, feed animals, or collect animal horns or bones.

donts.title: Don't drive off-road in national parks
donts.description: Strict park regulations in Chobe and Moremi prohibit off-roading to protect delicate riverbank habitats.

donts.title: Don't swim in open rivers or lagoons
donts.description: Okavango and Chobe waterways are home to large populations of wild hippos and Nile crocodiles; never swim in open water.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10% is customary in restaurants; tipping safari field guides ($10-15/day) and Mokoro polers ($5-10/excursion) is standard practice.
